wire.title: Sharing AI progress in mathematics
wire.summary: OpenAI publishes new results on open problems in mathematics from an internal frontier model and shares Lean proof formalizations and research details on GitHub.

wire.title: Advisory Group on Mathematics and Artificial Intelligence
wire.summary: OpenAI is working with an independent Advisory Group on Mathematics and Artificial Intelligence to guide the review and communication of emerging AI results.

wire.title: How GPT-5.6 Sol helps run quantum computing experiments
wire.summary: See how an MIT researcher uses GPT-5.6 Sol with Codex to autonomously run quantum computing experiments, analyze results, and calibrate qubits.

items.title: On the Navier–Stokes Millennium Prize Problem
items.summary: We’re sharing an AI-generated solution to the Navier–Stokes Millennium Prize Problem, including a writeup and a formal proof in Lean.

items.title: Rigidity, flexibility, and a sign error
items.summary: The documents [OAI26a, OAI26b, OAI26c] claimed to prove cases of the Hodge conjecture via homological mirror symmetry, before being withdrawn by OpenAI. We discuss the source of the error (but do not analyse the rest of the argument).

items.title: The Yau Geometric Conjecture for Isolated Hypersurface Singularities
